name: Outer Space
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of outer space, having formed the heavens, the earth, the sun, moon, and stars by His divine command (Genesis 1:1, 16). The heavens are described as the work of God's fingers, ordained and sustained by His power, with the earth suspended upon nothing, demonstrating His supreme authority over all creation (Job 26:7; Psalms 8:3). The firmament declares God's glory and handiwork, inspiring worship of His majesty and greatness (Psalms 19:1; 104:1).
